submission.justification: Unirradiated simulation shows T2 has the best resolution. Its minimum is near 150 µm (5.67 µm). The other thicknesses I simulated were worse: 7.04 at 50, 6.43 at 100, 6.26 at 200, 6.78 at 250 and 8.18 at 300 µm. T1 gave about 9 µm and T3 about 14 µm at 100 µm. I did not scan 125 µm or 175 µm, so the optimum could lie slightly away from 150 µm. No project document gives radiation-hardness data for any candidate, and the simulation is unirradiated only. I therefore could not verify that T2 survives the innermost-layer fluence. This needs confirming before the choice is final.

requirements.evidence: T2 at 150 µm gives 5.67 µm in simulation, versus about 9 µm for T1 and 14 µm for T3 at 100–150 µm. This is unirradiated.

requirements.requirement: One of the three listed technologies

requirements.evidence: No document gives radiation tolerance or fluence data for any candidate, and the simulation tool is unirradiated only. The resolution after irradiation was not evaluated.
